239: 	 * 
240: 	 * @param format		The output format of the thumbnail.
241: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
242: 	 */
243: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder format(String format) {
244: 		this.thumbnailFormat = format;
245: 		return this;
246: 	}
247: 	
248: 	/**
249: 	 * Sets the output format type of the thumbnail.
250: 	 * 
251: 	 * @param formatType	The output format type of the thumbnail.
252: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
253: 	 */
254: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder formatType(String formatType) {
255: 		this.thumbnailFormatType = formatType;
256: 		return this;
257: 	}
258: 	
259: 	/**
260: 	 * Sets the {@link ImageFilter}s to apply to the thumbnail.
261: 	 * <p>
262: 	 * These filters will be applied after the original image is resized.
263: 	 * 
264: 	 * @param filters		The output format type of the thumbnail.
265: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
266: 	 */
267: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder filters(List<ImageFilter> filters) {
268: 		if (filters == null) {
269: 			throw new NullPointerException("Filters is null.");
270: 		}
271: 		
272: 		this.filters = filters;
273: 		return this;
274: 	}
275: 	
276: 	/**
277: 	 * Sets the {@link Resizer} to use when performing the resizing operation
278: 	 * to create the thumbnail.
279: 	 * <p>
280: 	 * Calling this method after {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} will
281: 	 * cause the {@link ResizerFactory} used by the resulting
282: 	 * {@link ThumbnailParameter} to only return the specified {@link Resizer}.
283: 	 *
284: 	 * @param resizer		The {@link Resizer} to use when creating the
285: 	 * 						thumbnail.
286: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
287: 	 */
288: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder resizer(Resizer resizer) {
289: 		if (resizer == null) {
290: 			throw new NullPointerException("Resizer is null.");
291: 		}
292: 		
293: 		this.resizerFactory = new FixedResizerFactory(resizer);
294: 		return this;
295: 	}
296: 	
297: 	/**
298: 	 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} to use to obtain a {@link Resizer} when
299: 	 * performing the resizing operation to create the thumbnail.
300: 	 * <p>
301: 	 * Calling this method after {@link #resizer(Resizer)} could result in
302: 	 * {@link Resizer}s not specified in the {@code resizer} method to be used
303: 	 * when creating thumbnails.
304: 	 * 
305: 	 * 
306: 	 * @param resizerFactory	The {@link ResizerFactory} to use when obtaining
307: 	 * 							a {@link Resizer} to create the thumbnail.
308: 	 * @return					A reference to this object.
309: 	 * @since	0.4.0
310: 	 */
311: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder resizerFactory(ResizerFactory resizerFactory) {
312: 		if (resizerFactory == null) {
313: 			throw new NullPointerException("Resizer is null.");
314: 		}
315: 		
316: 		this.resizerFactory = resizerFactory;
317: 		return this;
318: 	}
319: 	
320: 	/**
321: 	 * Sets whether or not the thumbnail should fit within the specified
322: 	 * dimensions.
323: 	 * 
324: 	 * @param fit		{@code true} if the thumbnail should be sized to fit
325: 	 *					within the specified dimensions, if the thumbnail
326: 	 * 					is going to exceed those dimensions.
327: 	 * @return			A reference to this object.
328: 	 * @since	0.4.0
329: 	 */
330: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder fitWithinDimensions(boolean fit) {
331: 		this.fitWithinDimensions = fit;
332: 		return this;
333: 	}
334: 	
335: 	/**
336: 	 * Sets whether or not the Exif metadata should be used to determine the
337: 	 * orientation of the thumbnail.
338: 	 * 
339: 	 * @param use		{@code true} if the Exif metadata should be used
340: 	 * 					to determine the orientation of the thumbnail,
341: 	 * 					{@code false} otherwise.
342: 	 * @return			A reference to this object.
343: 	 * @since	0.4.3
344: 	 */
345: 	public ThumbnailParameterBuilder useExifOrientation(boolean use) {
346: 		this.useExifOrientation = use;
347: 		return this;
348: 	}
349: 
350: 	/**
351: 	 * Returns a {@link ThumbnailParameter} from the parameters which are
352: 	 * currently set.
353: 	 * <p>
354: 	 * This method will throw a {@link IllegalArgumentException} required
355: 	 * parameters for the {@link ThumbnailParameter} have not been set.
356: 	 * 
357: 	 * @return		A {@link ThumbnailParameter} with parameters set through
358: 	 * 				the use of this builder.
359: 	 * @throws IllegalStateException	If neither the size nor the scaling
360: 	 * 									factor has been set.
361: 	 */
362: 	public ThumbnailParameter build() {
363: 		if (!Double.isNaN(widthScalingFactor)) {
364: 			// If scaling factor has been set.
365: 			return new ThumbnailParameter(
366: 					widthScalingFactor,
367: 					heightScalingFactor,
368: 					sourceRegion,
369: 					keepAspectRatio,
370: 					thumbnailFormat,
371: 					thumbnailFormatType,
372: 					thumbnailQuality,
373: 					imageType,
374: 					filters,
375: 					resizerFactory,
376: 					fitWithinDimensions,
377: 					useExifOrientation
378: 			);
379: 
380: 		} else if (width != UNINITIALIZED && height != UNINITIALIZED) {
381: 			return new ThumbnailParameter(
382: 					new Dimension(width, height),
383: 					sourceRegion,
384: 					keepAspectRatio,
385: 					thumbnailFormat,
386: 					thumbnailFormatType,
387: 					thumbnailQuality,
388: 					imageType,
389: 					filters,
390: 					resizerFactory,
391: 					fitWithinDimensions,
392: 					useExifOrientation
393: 			);
394: 		} else {
